school_name: Citadel Military College of South Carolina
title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Citadel Military College of South Carolina
description: Late-night dining for Citadel cadets is defined by strict leave windows and the midnight gate closure. These spots provide essential fuel during weekend general leave or via delivery for upperclassmen.

cards.title: The On-Campus Standard
cards.subtitle: Mark Clark Hall
cards.notes: Located in the student center, this is the primary retail option for cadets. It serves as a reliable hub for chicken sandwiches and shakes before evening formations.
cards.short_summary: The central on-campus retail dining option for cadets located in Mark Clark Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A is located in Mark Clark Hall and is a fully licensed location serving the campus.
cards.source_title: Retail Dining - Auxiliary Services - The Citadel
cards.access_notes: Open until 7:00 PM on weekdays and 4:00 PM on Saturdays; closed Sundays.

cards.title: The Jumbo Slice Run
cards.subtitle: Upper King Street
cards.notes: Famous for massive 28-inch pizzas, this spot is a go-to for cadets on weekend leave. The jumbo slices are a high-calorie staple for those returning before the midnight curfew.
cards.short_summary: A popular pizza shop on King Street known for serving exceptionally large slices late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: Benny Ravello's is open until 1:00 AM Sunday-Wednesday and 2:00 AM Thursday-Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 2:00 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.

cards.title: The Post-Leave Tray
cards.subtitle: Savannah Highway
cards.notes: A short drive from campus, Cook Out is the ultimate late-night destination for its 'Trays' and 40+ milkshake flavors, often visited by upperclassmen with vehicle privileges.
cards.short_summary: A classic Southern fast-food chain offering budget-friendly trays and milkshakes until the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Out locations typically operate until 3:30 AM or 4:30 AM, serving as a primary late-night food source.
cards.source_title: Cookout Hours | What Time Does Cook Out Open & Close?
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:30 AM or later daily.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Safety Net
cards.subtitle: Savannah Highway
cards.notes: When all other options fail, Waffle House provides 24/7 service. It is a common meeting point for cadets on overnight leave or those needing a meal at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner chain that is a reliable late-night option for students and cadets in Charleston.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House locations in Charleston are open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

cards.title: The Window Order
cards.subtitle: Spring Street
cards.notes: Known for authentic Philly-style cheesesteaks, this walk-up window is a favorite for quick, late-night fuel. Cadets often stop here while navigating the downtown area.
cards.short_summary: A late-night cheesesteak shop offering authentic Philly-style subs through a walk-up window.
cards.evidence_claim: South Street Cheesesteaks is open daily from 9:00 AM to 3:00 AM.

cards.title: The Study Grind Hub
cards.subtitle: Mark Clark Hall
cards.notes: The primary caffeine source on campus, this Starbucks provides a space for cadets to study and socialize during the day and early evening hours.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus Starbucks location providing coffee and snacks to the Corps of Cadets.
cards.evidence_claim: Starbucks is located on the 1st floor of Mark Clark Hall on The Citadel campus.
cards.source_title: Retail Dining - Auxiliary Services - The Citadel
cards.access_notes: Typically open until 7:00 PM on weekdays.

cards.title: The Historic Snack Bar
cards.subtitle: Mark Clark Hall
cards.notes: Also known as the Munnerlyn Snack Bar, it offers deli sandwiches and flatbread pizzas. It is a traditional spot where cadets grab quick meals between duties.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining staple offering affordable deli and pizza options to the Citadel community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Canteen (Munnerlyn Snack Bar) is located on campus and serves breakfast and lunch items.
cards.access_notes: Primarily a breakfast and lunch destination; hours vary by semester.

cards.title: The Huger Street Hangout
cards.subtitle: Huger Street
cards.notes: Located near the campus gates, Taco Boy is a popular spot for cadets on leave to enjoy tacos and a vibrant atmosphere before returning to the barracks.
cards.short_summary: A lively Mexican-inspired restaurant located just outside the Citadel's campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Boy is located at 217 Huger Street and is a known dining spot for the local community.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM or midnight on weekends.

cards.title: The Walkable Dinner
cards.subtitle: Rutledge Avenue
cards.notes: One of the few restaurants within genuine walking distance of campus, Berkeley's offers sandwiches and comfort food for cadets on short leave windows.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood restaurant near The Citadel known for its sandwiches and proximity to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Berkeley's is noted as a walkable dining option from The Citadel campus.
cards.source_title: The Citadel Guide: Where to Eat, Drink & Stay in Charleston (2026)
cards.access_notes: Open for dinner; check seasonal hours for late-night availability.

cards.title: The King Street Nacho Run
cards.subtitle: King Street
cards.notes: A King Street mainstay for affordable Mexican-style food, this spot is a frequent late-night choice for students and cadets looking for a casual meal.
cards.short_summary: A casual Mexican restaurant on King Street popular for its late-night nacho and taco offerings.
cards.evidence_claim: Juanita Greenberg's is open daily until 2:00 AM.
